paper_title: Efficient Dual Mechanisms Boost the Efficiency of Ternary Solar Cells with Two Compatible Polymer Donors to Exceed 19%
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2024 - Liu - Efficient Dual Mechanisms Boost the Efficiency of Ternary Solar Cells with Two Compatible/auto/Advanced Materials - 2024 - Liu - Efficient Dual Mechanisms Boost the Efficiency of Ternary Solar Cells with Two Compatible.md

knowledge_points.content: The optimized ternary organic solar cell based on PM6:PBB-Cl:BTP-eC9 achieves a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 19.04%, with a short-circuit current density (JSC) of 28.53 mA cm⁻², an open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.853 V, and a fill factor (FF) of 78.23%.
knowledge_points.evidence: After adding 15 wt% PBB-Cl (compared to host donor), the optimized TOSC shows an outstanding PCE of 19.04% with JSC of 28.53 mA cm⁻², VOC of 0.853 V, and FF of 78.23%.

knowledge_points.content: The efficiency enhancement in the PM6:PBB-Cl:BTP-eC9 ternary system is attributed to dual mechanisms: Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) from the guest donor (PBB-Cl) to the host donor (PM6) and efficient charge transfer at the donor/acceptor (D/A) interfaces.
knowledge_points.evidence: A more profound mechanism for enhancing efficiency through dual mechanisms, that are the guest energy transfer to PM6 and charge transport at the donor/acceptor interface, has been proposed.

knowledge_points.content: The guest polymer donors PBB-F and PBB-Cl possess deeper HOMO energy levels compared to the host donor PM6, which leads to a quasi-linear increase in the open-circuit voltage (VOC) of the ternary solar cells as the guest donor ratio increases.
knowledge_points.evidence: It is observed that PBB-F and PBB-Cl possess deeper HOMO energy levels compared to that of PM6... the VOCs in TOSCs show a gradual improvement, exhibiting a quasi-linear dependence on PBB-F/Cl ratios, which suggests the presence of the alloy-like mode.

knowledge_points.content: PBB-F and PBB-Cl are wide bandgap polymer donors designed using benzo(1,2-d:4,5-d')dithiazole (BBT) as the acceptor unit, specifically chosen to provide absorption complementary to the solar spectrum in the 500-600 nm range.
knowledge_points.evidence: two PDs PBB-F and PBB-Cl based on benzo(1,2- d:4,5-d')dithiazole (BBT) as acceptor unit were selected, which exhibit excellent absorption within strong solar radiation.

knowledge_points.content: The PM6:PBB-Cl:BTP-eC9 ternary solar cells exhibit superior thermal stability compared to binary PM6:BTP-eC9 cells, retaining over 90% of their initial PCE after 720 hours of annealing at 60°C in a nitrogen atmosphere.
knowledge_points.evidence: The TOSCs with PBB-Cl exhibited remarkable retention of over 90% PCE even after undergoing 720 h at 60 °C surpassing the binary OSC (500 h).

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis indicates that the addition of PBB-Cl as a third component reduces the π-π stacking distance from 3.81 Å in the binary PM6:BTP-eC9 blend to 3.76 Å in the ternary blend, while increasing the crystal coherence length (CCL).
knowledge_points.evidence: The π-π stacking distances of binary, PBB-F, and PBB-Cl ternary blend films are 3.81, 3.78, and 3.76 Å, respectively... Besides, the CCLs of π-π stacking along OOP direction in binary, PBB-F, and PBB-Cl ternary blend films are 21.89, 22.31, and 22.56 Å, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The compatibility between PM6 and PBB-Cl is exceptionally high, as evidenced by a low Flory-Huggins interaction parameter (χ) of 0.037 K and a low interfacial energy (γ) of 0.82 mN m⁻¹, facilitating the formation of an alloy-like phase.
knowledge_points.evidence: It can be seen that the χ of 0.037 K for PM6:PBB-Cl is the smallest one... the γ value is the smallest of only 0.82 mN m⁻¹... which further proves the excellent compatibility between two donors.

knowledge_points.content: PBB-Cl-based ternary solar cells demonstrate balanced charge carrier mobilities, with a hole mobility (μh) of 5.95 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and an electron mobility (μe) of 5.77 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, resulting in a μe/μh ratio of 1.03.
knowledge_points.evidence: Notably, the PBB-Cl-based TOSC exhibits a μh of 5.95 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and μe of 5.77 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹... TOSCs display a μe/μh ratio of 1.06 and 1.03, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: DFT calculations at the B3LYPD3/def2-SVP level show that the π-π stacking distance between PM6 and PBB-Cl is 3.51 Å, which is significantly shorter than the self-stacking distance of PM6 (3.71 Å), supporting the formation of a stable alloy-like structure.
knowledge_points.evidence: The π-π stacking distance between PM6 and PBB-F/PBB-Cl is approximately 3.54 Å / 3.51 Å which is significantly smaller than the stacking distances observed self-PM6 (3.71 A).

knowledge_points.content: Transient photocurrent (TPC) measurements reveal that the charge extraction time (τext) decreases from 3.79 µs in the binary device to 0.89 µs in the PBB-Cl-based ternary device, indicating faster charge sweep-out.
knowledge_points.evidence: The charge extraction time (τext) values estimated from fittings TPC decays... for the binary, TOSCs with PBB-F and PBB-Cl are fitted to be 3.79, 1.63, and 0.89 µs, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized device architecture for these high-efficiency ternary solar cells is a conventional structure consisting of ITO/PEDOT:PSS/active layer/PDINN/Ag.
knowledge_points.evidence: a conventional configuration of ITO/PEDOT:PSS/active layer/PDINN/Ag were prepared, as shown in Figure 2a.

knowledge_points.content: The improved thermal stability in the ternary system is attributed to the reduction in spatial site resistance and the formation of a more tightly entangled long-chain structure between the two polymer donors.
knowledge_points.evidence: Furthermore, the TOSCs exhibit better thermal stability than that of binary OSCs due to the reduction in spatial site resistance resulting from a more tightly entangled long-chain structure.
